acceptance_signals: A sanitized dated diagnostic compares the repository data-files declaration, wheel data-key mapping, pip installation destination mapping, and Windows virtual-environment sysconfig data scheme without building or installing an AgentGov wheel.
The prior combined shared-template gate is decomposed into location correctness, installed presence, and installed byte-identity conclusions; every unavailable conclusion remains explicitly unknown.
The diagnostic states whether a future exact-current-source build/install with retained artifacts is required before independent rehearsal v2.
STATUS.md and the dated development log describe the diagnostic result without claiming installed-template correctness or rehearsal completion.
The previous short-build-root script and its evidence file remain byte-identical, product source and packaging metadata remain outside scope, and repository validation remains green.

decision.rationale: The accountable human reviewed structured proposal prp-74dea4e1c20346fe87a9eeb83cfef63c and admitted that exact task through an explicit admission control.

requirement.summary: Using only repository-local declarations and already installed local Python or pip implementation metadata, determine whether the prior Windows virtual-environment shared-template check targeted the correct data location, separate location, presence, and byte-identity conclusions, preserve unresolved branches explicitly, and record whether another retained-artifact build/install inspection is required before independent rehearsal v2. Do not change product source, packaging metadata, or the previous short-build-root implementation.

items: Static contracts can establish an intended destination but cannot retroactively prove presence or byte identity in a removed runtime.
Pip internal implementation details are locally authoritative for the installed tool version but are not a cross-version compatibility guarantee.
The dirty worktree makes accidental scope expansion possible; excluded paths and included predecessor artifacts must remain unchanged.
No wheel build, project installation, model call, rehearsal, network access, credential use, Git mutation, publication, release, deployment, or external write is authorized.
